resolved_conflicts.explanation: tnlandforms and Forest Lookouts call the site Aetna; the NGS datasheet for the linked mark FC1879 calls it Whiteside TSFS Lot SC 36 and describes a lookout tower there. The story reports both names and does not assert that they are the same structure, although the tnlandforms row links the mark to Aetna.
tnlandforms gives 1,915 ft; the NGS NAVD 88 height is 1,916 ft, scaled from a topographic map. The story uses 1,915 ft with the tnlandforms source.

notes_for_editor: The Aetna row in tnlandforms links to NGS PID FC1879, and the legend on that page says six-character Info codes are NGS datasheet PIDs. The datasheet puts the mark in Marion County at a T.S.F.S. lookout tower it calls SC 36 and gives a 1961 description. Record coordinates (35.0179, -85.4913) are about 16 m from the NGS position (35 01 04.19864 N, 085 29 29.24673 W) by our arithmetic; this supports one site, but no source says so, so the story does not claim it. The brief's registers entry 'NGS FC 1879' matches the PID apart from the space. The 55 ft height is converted to 16.8 m. Searches: one per tower plus one shared search. The Nashville Scene article on Aetna Mountain returned HTTP 429 and was not read; the search snippet did not describe the tower.
